memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Emaar Properties remains Watchlist, with no position. Four matching issuer disclosures now allow the standalone second-quarter sales calculation: approximately AED 4.2bn in 2026 versus approximately AED 26.7bn in 2025, about 84% lower. This supports the slowdown direction, but the original deadline wording is ambiguous, so the forecast is not counted as a timely hit. Recognized half-year revenue and profit still grew, and launch timing complicates a pure demand-collapse explanation. A new conditional cash offer for Emaar Development minorities adds a funding question: full acceptance would require approximately AED 11.903bn of share consideration before unspecified fees, not cash already spent. Sufficient-resources wording does not prove the source of financing or the post-offer cash position. Keep watching for take-up and an unrestricted-cash/debt bridge. The parent dividend and owner-action forecasts remain open. Price-only opportunity cost is observable, but matched benchmark returns and investment skill are not established.
